Rounded to the **nearest integer**, the area of $△ABC$ is{{field-1}} ${\text{mi}}^{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}bc\operatorname{sin}⁡A,
$$

where $∠A$ is between the sides of lengths $b$ and $c.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}с & =AB=36, \\ b & =AC=36, \\ m∠A & ={70}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{70}^{∘}=0.939\,693,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 36\cdot 36\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{70}^{∘} \\  & =648\cdot (0.939\,693) \\  & ≈609\,{\text{mi}}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the **nearest integer**.
